App details

Ham Tools / Radio RF Toolkit

Radio tools for wavelength, power, signal calculations, locators and Morse practice.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

A practical offline toolkit for radio enthusiasts. Work with wavelength, power, antenna matching and signal paths using your own parameters. Convert coordinates to Maidenhead locators, calculate distance and bearing between stations, and practise Morse.

Main features

  • Frequency, wavelength and cable velocity factor.
  • Power, antenna mismatch and entered cable losses.
  • Maidenhead locators, distance and bearing.
  • Morse conversion, playback and practice.

This app is planned. The description presents documented plans, not an app available to download. The final design and app still need approval and testing; there is no announced release date.

How to use

Select an RF calculator and enter frequency, power or line parameters with units. Convert frequency to wavelength, apply cable velocity factor, compare forward and reflected power, or build a signal budget from gains and losses. Enter coordinates or Maidenhead locators to find station distance and bearing. Type text for Morse conversion, playback and practice.

Important limits

Calculations use your parameters; no automatic antenna correction, terrain propagation or callsign database is supplied. Optional maps need their own connection, while RF and locator calculations work without maps.

Offline use, permissions and purchases

The planned core functions run on the device without a JN86 account. Advertising, purchases, optional downloads and external links may need an internet connection. Offline core operation does not rule out separate service data flows.

Android 7.0 or newer is the common planned baseline. Individual sensor and platform features still depend on the device.

Permissions

Core calculations and Morse do not need location or microphone. An optional map or current-station flow may request location when needed and use an external map service.

Local data

Calculator drafts and Morse practice scores would be session data. Preferences persist locally; no calculation history, saved station favorites or long-term learning profile is planned.

Advertising and purchases

The plan keeps every core feature free, with banner advertising and an optional one-time Google Play purchase to remove ads. There is no subscription. Actual local prices will come from Play; advertising providers, consent choices and SDK data handling must be specified before launch.

First version and later ideas

The functions above belong to the documented plan for the first version. Features mentioned below as excluded or later ideas are not promised as current capabilities.

Velocity factor, entered cable losses and station distance belong to the first version. Full antenna design, SDR analysis and large online databases are excluded.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
